properties.name: Confederate States of America
properties.source: Compromise of 1850 (Texas south of 36°30' N and east of 103° W, its line with New Mexico at 32° N) and the Rio Grande, Texas's line with Mexico by the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo
properties.method: Texas's lines with New Mexico and the Indian Territory from the Compromise of 1850, the Rio Grande traced through El Paso, Presidio, Boquillas, Del Rio, Eagle Pass, Laredo, Rio Grande City, Reynosa and Brownsville, and the Red River line kept just south of the river, where Cliopatria's Confederate shape holds the land. A pocket draws only the stateless land inside it.
